ChangeSpeed

Source: R/speed_modifier.R
ChangeSpeedClass.Rd

Modifies the speed of an animation. speedinfo maps nodes (proportions of the animation's run_time) to speed factors; between two nodes the speed changes smoothly. The run time of the wrapped animation is stretched accordingly. An AnimationGroup() with any lag_ratio counts as one animation.

Updaters added with change_speed_add_updater() follow the modified speed while a ChangeSpeed with affects_speed_updaters = TRUE plays.

Usage

ChangeSpeed(
  anim,
  speedinfo,
  rate_func = NULL,
  affects_speed_updaters = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

anim

The animation (or mob$animate builder) to modify.

speedinfo

Named numeric vector or list: names are the nodes in [0, 1], values the speed factors, for example c("0.3" = 1, "0.4" = 0.1, "0.6" = 0.1, "1" = 1). A missing node 0 gets speed 1 and a missing node 1 gets the speed of the last node.

rate_func

Overrides the rate function of anim; it is applied before changing the speed.

affects_speed_updaters

Whether updaters added with change_speed_add_updater() follow the speed change. Only one such animation can play at a time.

...

Passed to Animation().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
SpeedModifierExample <- manim_scene(function(self) {
  a <- Dot()$shift(LEFT * 4)
  b <- Dot()$shift(RIGHT * 4)
  self$add(a, b)
  self$play(ChangeSpeed(
    AnimationGroup(a$animate(run_time = 1)$shift(RIGHT * 8),
                   b$animate(run_time = 1)$shift(LEFT * 8)),
    speedinfo = c("0.3" = 1, "0.4" = 0.1, "0.6" = 0.1, "1" = 1),
    rate_func = linear))
})
} # }
